title: Customer request triage matrix for data-control policy exceptions
creator: Daniel Park
description:
Create a pragmatic intake + prioritization matrix and operator playbook specifically for customer requests that ask for exceptions to standard data-controls (logging redaction, retention changes, PII handling, and audit exports). This ticket scopes the PM deliverable: intake form, automated scoring rubric, decision SLA tiers, escalation paths to security/compliance, and a lightweight approvals template for account teams. Focus is non-bug product requests from enterprise customers that require policy deviation or manual controls.

Goals:
- Reduce decision latency for control-exception requests to SLA tiers (1-3 business days depending on risk).
- Make decisions auditable with minimal back-and-forth and clear owner rotation.
- Ensure consistent risk assessment across requests (data sensitivity, regulatory scope, technical feasibility, long-term support cost).
- Integrate with Support/Account Management and Security review flows so enterprise customers get clear expectations and remediation steps.

Out of scope: engineering implementation of redaction/retention systems; this ticket defines gating, prioritization, and operator-runbook plus feedback loops for product/eng work to follow.
acceptance_criteria: A templated intake form exists in Confluence and Support (Zendesk) with fields: customer, environment, request type, affected endpoints, sample data, business rationale, requested SLA, regulatory citation, suggested mitigation
A weighted scoring rubric is defined and documented (risk, frequency, technical effort, contractual obligation) and yields a numeric priority and recommended SLA tier
Escalation matrix maps each score range to: auto-approve, PM review, security review, legal review, or exec escalation
Operator playbook contains step-by-step for approvals, required audit log entries, communication templates to customers, and follow-up actions for engineering work
Pilot run completed with at least 3 active customer requests and documented outcomes (decision time, approvals, follow-ups)
SLA expectations published to account teams and integrated into Support triage workflow
implementation_notes: Phase 1: Draft intake form and rubric; align with Security and Legal on risk signals (PII, PCI, healthcare) - owner: PM
Phase 2: Implement form in Zendesk macros + Confluence checklist; create webhook to tag Linear/PM pipeline - owner: Solutions Engineering
Phase 3: Train Support and AMs; run 3-week pilot with top 5 enterprise accounts - owner: Customer Success
Phase 4: Iterate rubric thresholds based on pilot outcomes; finalize operator runbook and handoff to ops - owner: PM + Security
Note: keep engineering changes separated as follow-on RFCs to avoid blocking the triage flow deliverable
